record_type_quote: The current study is a high-powered, pre-registered direct replication attempt of the effect found by Boayue et al. (2020).

targets.authors: Boayue Nya M., Csifcsák G., Kreis I.V., Schmidt C., Finn I., Hovde Vollsund A.E., Mittner M.
targets.title: The interplay between executive control, behavioural variability and mind wandering: insights from a high-definition transcranial direct-current stimulation study.
targets.evidence_quote: The main goal of the current study was to replicate the effect that MW propensity can be reduced by HD-tDCS of the left DLPFC reported by Boayue et al. (2020) using a high-powered, pre-registered protocol.
targets.outcome_quote: The main goal of the current study was to replicate the effect that MW propensity can be reduced by HD-tDCS of the left DLPFC reported by Boayue et al. (2020) using a high-powered, pre-registered protocol. However, we found that HD-tDCS did not reduce or otherwise affect the propensity to MW in our study.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The central stimulation effect and title-focused claim failed. Confirmed behavioral markers do not rescue the central finding; the predicted behavioral interaction also failed.

reasoning: New participants directly retest the 2020 HD-tDCS study. Other cited stimulation papers and neural-marker studies are background or exploratory extensions, not additional designed replication targets. Meta-analytic integration of old and new samples is not a separate reproduction.
